content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Candidate must have passed at least 10th standard examination. Other conditions: Legal Volunteer position is not a job in any way. Candidates from various categories such as teachers, MSW students, Anganwadi workers, students, social workers, self-help group members, and well-behaved prisoners/literate prisoners are eligible.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DLSA Wardha Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are not considered in any other way than offline submission with the QR code information.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Only honorarium as per NALSA Para Legal Volunteer scheme (revised) when work is assigned; no salary, remuneration or allowance otherwise.

content_sections.heading: How Will DLSA Wardha Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications Selection based on eligibility

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational and experience certificates Aadhar card and passport size photo Declaration form

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Wardha Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain application format and declaration from the notification. Fill in information completely and scan the provided QR code to fill details. Attach required eligibility documents. Submit the offline application to the office by 06-11-2026 up to 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Wardha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Wardha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 100 vacancies for Legal Volunteer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DLSA Wardha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (PDF Pages 3 and 5) and send it to District Legal Services Authority, Wardha, by offline, to reach by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium / Daily allowance as per NALSA scheme (no extra salary/wages).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum 10th standard pass.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Legal Volunteer position is not a job in any way. Candidates from various categories such as teachers, MSW students, Anganwadi workers, students, social workers, self-help group members, and well-behaved prisoners/literate prisoners are eligible.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are not considered in any other way than offline submission with the QR code information.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Selection based on eligibility.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Wardha District.
